description: Load EstatisticasFraudesPix on the live ingest path. The contract and the seeded dbt source already exist. ENTITY_ORDER does not include it, so make ingest never writes the partition.
steps: Add FRAUDES to ENTITY_ORDER only after the client can filter AnoMes and still refuses a saturated page when $skip returns HTTP 500.
Keep $count unused. The service returns HTTP 403.
Write a fixture month through the existing Parquet writer and extend the unit test that builds the schema.
Run make test and make dbt-build on write_sample_raw output. Do not call the live Olinda host from CI.
Confirm the mart still says contested via MED and does not rename the counts to fraud.
Leave the in-progress America/Sao_Paulo month out of the watermark.

description: Load CnaePorteRecebedor on the live ingest path. The dashboard mart currently reads the seeded extract. vlcompra, vldinespec, and mesmatit stay off the v1.0 dashboards.
steps: Add CNAE to ENTITY_ORDER with the same $filter and page rules as the other function imports.
Cover the writer schema with a unit test and a singular dbt test that the receiver grain does not drop the published Outros bucket.
Run make test and make dbt-build against fixture Parquet.
Do not put precautionary-block columns on a dashboard in this feature.

description: Load PixUsuariosCadastradosDICT. It is an entity set, not a function import, so it needs a second read path. The published total is a user stock, not a key count.
steps: Implement the entity-set read without $count and without treating a failed $skip as a complete month.
Snapshot the month-end date the spike documented. Do not invent a daily series.
Add a dbt test that usuarios_total is the published total and is not summed from ChavesPix.
Run make test and make dbt-build on fixture Parquet. Live HTTP stays out of CI.

description: Reconcile municipality payer and receiver totals to the national SPI cube, with an explicit residual for the N/D row and the SPI-only scope. v1.0 states that these figures are not reconciled.
steps: Add a singular dbt test or model that compares municipality sums to fct_pix_transactions for a closed month and records the gap instead of hiding it.
Keep the N/D row. Do not drop a null IBGE code to make the totals match.
State in the model description that both sides are SPI-settled and that the comparison is not an official BCB reconciliation.
Run make dbt-build on the fixture. The test must fail the build if the residual is unexplained, not if the residual is merely non-zero and documented.

description: Keep the AWS apply path documented and unapplied. An agent must not apply the stack. A human with an account is the only caller of the workflow_dispatch deploy.
steps: Read docs/runbooks/aws-dev.md against infra/terraform and list any step the runbook names that the Terraform does not implement.
Run make tf-check when terraform is installed. init uses -backend=false.
Confirm the diff contains no terraform apply, no terraform destroy, and no aws mutating call.
Leave passes false until a human records, outside an agent session, that the account was applied. An agent does not flip this feature.

description: The v1.0 dashboard marts are not in transform/athena/views.sql, and dbt build --target athena has not been run. Publishing them is a later slice and still does not apply Terraform by itself.
steps: Write an ADR if the Athena target becomes the dashboard path. ADR-007 keeps Metabase on local DuckDB.
Extend the parse-only Athena check so the new models parse with skip_workgroup_check and no AWS call.
Do not run the target against a workgroup from an agent session.
Run make test and make dbt-build on DuckDB.

description: Optional Spark slice for a portfolio reader who wants a second engine. No Spark code exists. This starts with an ADR, not a cluster.
steps: Write the next ADR that says what Spark would read, what stays on DuckDB, and why the local demo still does not need a cluster.
Do not add a dependency or a cluster config in the same change as the ADR.
Point the ADR at make dbt-build as the check that must stay green.

description: Optional product-AI slice. Nothing in the repo calls a model. An ADR has to land before any prompt, eval, or API client.
steps: Write an ADR that names the question the model would answer, the tables it may read, and the fact it must not invent a MED or fraud figure.
Do not add an API key, a secret, or a vendor SDK in that ADR slice.
Keep make test and make dbt-build green.
